noether-charge-integral-de768919.title: The Noether Charge (Global Invariant)
noether-charge-integral-de768919.interpretation: Defines the conserved scalar charge as the spatial integral of the zero-component of the Noether four-current density over a Cauchy surface.
noether-charge-integral-de768919.symmetry_origin: The global aggregation of local symmetry transformations across the entire field manifold.
noether-charge-integral-de768919.limits_and_boundary: Remains identically constant over time provided the current flux vanishes at the spatial boundaries of the system.

qed-minimal-coupling-vertex-5b1cd7b1.title: Minimal Coupling Vertex
qed-minimal-coupling-vertex-5b1cd7b1.interpretation: Defines the fundamental interaction vertex between a charged fermion and the electromagnetic gauge field.
qed-minimal-coupling-vertex-5b1cd7b1.symmetry_origin: The geometric coupling necessitated by the gauge principle.
qed-minimal-coupling-vertex-5b1cd7b1.limits_and_boundary: Determines the probability amplitude for photon emission and absorption in Feynman diagrams.

qcd-cornell-potential-interaction-bae38c.title: Cornell Potential (QCD)
qcd-cornell-potential-interaction-bae38c.interpretation: Describes the effective potential between two quarks, combining the Coulomb-like behavior at short distances with the linear confinement term at large distances.
qcd-cornell-potential-interaction-bae38c.symmetry_origin: The non-abelian gauge symmetry of SU(3) and the flux-tube nature of the gluon field.
qcd-cornell-potential-interaction-bae38c.limits_and_boundary: As $r \to \infty$, the linear term $\kappa r$ necessitates an infinite energy to separate quarks, enforcing confinement.

bell-chsh-inequality-ident-93081f9a.title: CHSH Inequality (Bell)
bell-chsh-inequality-ident-93081f9a.interpretation: Sets the maximum possible correlation between two spatially separated particles for any theory based on local hidden variables (Local Realism).
bell-chsh-inequality-ident-93081f9a.symmetry_origin: The assumption of local realism and the independence of measurement choices.
bell-chsh-inequality-ident-93081f9a.limits_and_boundary: A violation of this inequality (S > 2) identically shatters the possibility of a local, deterministic description of the vacuum.
